title: Industrial Practice of LLM-Based Test Case Carving and Assertion Generation (Experience Paper)
abstract: arXiv:2607.24000v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Enterprise regression testing for microservice systems is often constrained by incomplete or outdated documentation. In practice, QA engineers frequently rely on real execution traffic to reconstruct business scenarios; however, turning raw traffic into replayable regression tests with stable validation logic remains labor-intensive and error-prone.   This paper presents NL2Test, an end-to-end approach and tool that generates executable API regression tests from (i) a natural-language scenario description and (ii) a traffic capture recorded while executing the scenario. NL2Test addresses two coupled tasks: test case carving, which extracts a minimal replayable request sequence and reconstructs data dependencies so that dynamic values are bound from their responses rather than hard-coded; and assertion generation, which produces assertions aligned with business intent while avoiding non-deterministic fields and hallucinated paths. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的测试用例切分与断言生成的工业实践（经验论文）
translated_abstract: 企业针对微服务系统的回归测试常常受到文档不完整或过时的限制。在实践中，QA工程师经常依赖真实的执行流量来重建业务场景；然而，将原始流量转化为具有稳定验证逻辑的可重放回归测试仍然是一项劳动密集且容易出错的工作。本文提出了NL2Test，这是一种端到端的方法和工具，能够从自然语言场景描述以及执行该场景时记录的流量捕获中生成可执行的API回归测试。NL2Test解决了两个相互耦合的任务：测试用例切分，即提取最小化的可重放请求序列并重建数据依赖关系，使动态值从其响应中绑定而不是硬编码；以及断言生成，即生成与业务意图一致的断言，同时避免非确定性字段和幻觉路径。
tldr: 本文提出NL2Test，一种基于大语言模型的端到端方法与工具，能够从自然语言场景描述和真实流量记录中自动生成可执行的API回归测试，同时解决测试用例切分（提取最小可重放请求序列并重建数据依赖）与断言生成（对齐业务意图并避免幻觉路径）两大耦合任务。
en_tdlr: This paper presents NL2Test, an LLM-based end-to-end approach and tool that automatically generates executable API regression tests from natural-language scenario descriptions and real traffic captures, jointly addressing test case carving (extracting minimal replayable request sequences with reconstructed data dependencies) and assertion generation (aligning with business intent while avoiding hallucinated paths).
